invariants.name: dock_does_not_layout_full_tree
invariants.note: Dock splitter resize must not layout the whole 45-entity chrome. Live dump layouts 25; cap 40 so one extra chrome node does not false-fail and a full-tree 45 fails. Do not use <=25 or panes==8 as the pass.

invariants.name: dock_does_not_extract_full_tree
invariants.note: Live dump extract-changes 33 of 45; cap 40 so modest chrome growth passes and a full-tree 45 fails. Do not pin ==33.

notes: Mapped onto AppContext assemble_dock of an 8-leaf DockNode split tree plus adjust_focused_dock_split in an isolated AppContext. Measures keyboard/API splitter resize that rebuilds chrome. Does not measure pointer-drag splitter, dock tear-off, or a host pointer-pump loop.
